Private wb As Object, kept As Variant

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    kept = Array(Application.Iteration, Application.MaxChange, Application.MaxIterations, Application.SheetsInNewWorkbook)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "audit.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
    Application.Iteration = kept(0): Application.MaxChange = kept(1)
    Application.MaxIterations = kept(2): Application.SheetsInNewWorkbook = kept(3)
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 40 Then
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function StateValidation(ws As Object) As String
